Day 5

Move Better, Feel Better

(Daily Movement & Posture Reset)

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

Even perfect posture gets stiff if you hold it all day. Today is about adding small amounts of movement through your day.

Today's 3 movements

1
 Stand 2 to 3 minutes every hour
Phone calls are a great time to stand.
2
 Add simple stretches
Neck rolls, shoulder rolls and a gentle back stretch.
3
 Hydrate and breathe
Drink water, take a few slow, deep breaths. Awareness is half the work.
▶  Watch the Day 5 movement video
Tip: Your cushion and lumbar support keep you aligned when you sit back down, so movement and support work together.
